youtube_meta.title: You Didn't Know It Was the Last Time... | Surreal AI Film (4K)
youtube_meta.description:
I've been carrying this one for a while.
Not the writing - just the feeling. That we move through the most important moments of our lives not knowing that's what they are.
The last time someone drove you somewhere. The last time the house was full. The last time you heard a voice you'd give anything to hear again.
It looked like a Tuesday. It looked like nothing much at all.
I hope this finds you on a day when there's still time to call.

🎵 You Didn't Know It Was the Last Time 00:00

All music and lyrics written by me. Visuals built frame by frame from my own concepts and direction. I use AI the way a filmmaker uses a camera. Everything you feel here came from a person, not a machine.

#surrealaifilm #aishortfilm #music #oltsevart

top_comments.author: @retiredyeti5555
top_comments.text: When I told my wife " Go to sleep, I'm right here, I love you.  I'll see you when you wake.", I didn't know that was the last time I would utter those words to her in this life.  That was 9 months ago. But I believe in the Resurrection, and therefore I know that I will see her when she wakes.  God keeps the promises he makes and he has promised that we will live again after the Resurrection.

top_comments.author: @KIDavis-t6z
top_comments.text: Who else wishes they could have a do-over, but with all the knowledge and wisdom that they have now??

top_comments.author: @marphi333
top_comments.text: The days are long & the years are short, until there are no more...

top_comments.author: @Metal-Mash-Diversify
top_comments.text: I just lay my buddy, my son ... my support dog to rest just days ago and all of a sudden, the vid popped up and i like others began crying before the vid ever started.  He passed on the anniversary of my spouse passing just a couple of years back.   The emotions raw, I cried all the way through and even now with the vid even on .....   Great vid and so much emotion.   Added to my "Songs for the broken heart" playlist

top_comments.author: @unwrangler11
top_comments.text: This message will really hit home when it really is the last time for a loved one. I thought I appreciated those loved ones around me, but when suddenly they were gone, it hit me like a ton of bricks. Please, if you still have time with a loved one, cherish it.

top_comments.author: @katiemeloan7897
top_comments.text: And we didn't know it was the last time, until it's too late. We can't go back. Can't raise our departed loved ones. Can't make the clocks run backwards. Can't undo or unsay anything. Thank you for this beautiful bittersweet reminder, Oltsev. Thank you.

top_comments.author: @howardbarnes3714
top_comments.text:
My husband Howard died yesterday, Pentecost,  in an Oxford hospital. I was with him all the day before, knowing he would die. I took a photo of his dear warm hand on the bed cover, and of mine holding his. Precious. 
I know he is at peace in the Light of The Lord's Kingdom, so I am at peace too. Margaret UK ❤
